[LLEX.10.8.1] **Classification.** `NAME` and `TYPE_SYM` are classified per
codepoint against the pinned Unicode version ([LNAM.2.2.5]): `NAME` against
`XID`, NFC-normalized before interning; `TYPE_SYM` against `XID` ∪ the
non-`XID` unit-glyph set. Keywords retain their contextual priority, so they
win over `NAME` ([LLEX.9]).
